Dear Miss Yonge,
I have sent on to [Miss Sewell](/person/1301) Mr Pearson’s book. Could you tell [me](/person/939) how much - how many pages - you want to use.[^1] I think I may have an opportunity of seeing him soon. He is not likely to refuse.
The story of the Hermits(?) is really wonderful. I cannot tell you how that of Anthony [illegible] me. What moral pictures there must have been there.
I am urging the printers to make speed.
Yours very faithfully
A. Macmillan


[^1]: Pearson\'s book was excerpted in both [Historical Selections](/book/71) and its continuation [European History](/book/82).
